name: Hello Plugin (Node)
summary: A Node template: one command in the file menu that tells you how many items you chose.
description: Copy this folder, change the id (reverse domain, lowercase), the name and the publisher, then edit run.js. Needs Node.js, which you install yourself (nodejs.org or Homebrew). Run `vektor-plugin validate .` to check it, `vektor-plugin test . test/checks.json` to test it, and load it in Vektor with Developer mode on (Settings ▸ Plugins ▸ Load Plugin from Folder…).

items.label: Greeting
items.help: What the command says before the number of items.

banner.text: This plugin needs Node.js. Install it from nodejs.org or with Homebrew (brew install node); a copy managed by nvm, fnm or Volta is not found by Vektor.
